purpose: RTS可登城墙、墙顶与塔楼的立体绿色上箭头鼠标贴图

runtimeContract.ownership: RTSCommand resolves semantics; GameScene owns cursor rendering

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game UI cursor sprite for a medieval fortress RTS. Primary request: a single three-dimensional upward-pointing green arrow that communicates climb onto this elevated structure. Subject: one bold vertical arrow, arrowhead pointing precisely toward the top of the canvas, chunky extruded body, compact and highly readable at 64 to 96 pixels. Style/medium: polished isometric 3D game UI icon, classic medieval fortress strategy-game visual language, original design. Composition/framing: centered single object, front three-quarter isometric view, generous transparent safety margin, balanced silhouette. Lighting/mood: restrained top-left highlight, tactical and confident. Color palette: vivid emerald green front face, lime highlight on bevels, deep forest-green side faces, thin charcoal cold-steel outer edge. Materials/textures: beveled painted metal or carved enamel, subtle wear only, crisp edges. Constraints: genuinely transparent RGBA background; exactly one arrow; no platform; no circle; no cursor hand; no text; no letters; no numbers; no emblem; no logo; no watermark; no cast shadow outside the arrow; arrow must remain legible when downscaled. Avoid: neon bloom, excessive glow, cartoon sticker look, flat vector appearance, photorealistic scene, buildings, walls, people, extra symbols.
